editorial:
Imagine a world where you could grow a human being from a baby to an adult in just a few days. That is exactly what happens here. You follow a scientist who finds a way to speed up the growth of a fetus in a lab. It sounds like a cool science project at first, but things get weird and creepy fast. The vibe is very much like those old school movies where science goes totally wrong, and you are left wondering if the creator is actually the villain of the story.

The acting is pretty solid for the time, and the way the character grows up on screen keeps you glued to your seat. While the pacing slows down a bit in the middle, the shock factor makes up for it. If you like weird stories about playing god, you will love this. Since it is an older film, you might want to track down a 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to get the best picture. If you are in a rush, renting it on Apple TV is a great way to see it without spending too much money.
endingExplained: The fast-grown woman eventually turns on her creator and becomes a killer. She tries to take over and get rid of anyone in her way. In the end, the scientist realizes he made a monster that cannot be controlled. The movie wraps up with a tense showdown where the creation is finally stopped, showing that skipping the natural process of growing up leads to a complete lack of a soul or a conscience.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school mad scientist movies and weird twists.
